name: Chikai no Kiss wa Totsuzen ni
source:
‘Let’s pretend just for a while that we’re married!’ 
A rather unexpected request which you’ve accepted without giving it a serious thought.

What started out as a dreadful task slowly becomes more pleasant. And it seems like you’re slowly getting drawn to his charm. Will a relationship that started out as a lie work out well?

Throw yourself into a whole new life and experience a whirlwind marriage in this female-oriented romance game! 

[from [url=http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/my-forged-wedding/id504751530?mt=8]iTunes Store[/url]]
translation:
“我们暂时假装成夫妻吧！”
面对这突如其来的请求，你没怎么认真考虑便答应下来。

这项起初令人头疼的任务，渐渐变得愉快；而你似乎也在一点点被他的魅力吸引。这段始于谎言的关系，最终能否迎来圆满结局？

投身全新生活，在这款女性向恋爱游戏中体验一场旋风般的婚姻！

[引自[url=http://itunes.apple.com/us/app/my-forged-wedding/id504751530?mt=8]iTunes Store[/url]]
